objective: Remove the Invite button entirely, its logic and its look, leaving the compose + button as the only floating control.
acceptance_criteria: Start gate: FRONTEND-036 has merged to main. Test-first: commit the failing tests alone before the implementation; the implementation commit edits no test.

components/ui/InviteButton.tsx, InviteButton.module.css and InviteButton.test.tsx are deleted, and AppLayout renders no Invite control: no element named Invite, Copied or Link copied, no clipboard call and no copy-fallback card, signed in or not, at any route.
No file under frontend/src imports or names InviteButton. LinkIcon is deleted from components/ui/icons with its test cases if nothing else uses it, and the icons file's header count is corrected.

The compose + button keeps its markup, accessible name, position and stacking exactly as on main before this unit, its dialog anchor and its focus behaviour; tests that pinned Invite's place beside it (AppLayout.test.tsx, floating-clearance.test.ts, ui-css.test.ts) drop the Invite cases and keep every compose case. main's bottom padding still clears the + button and, below 40em, the bar.
Tab order: from the last nav item straight to main's content; the + button stays where it was in the order.

frontend/src/test/bundle-budgets/FRONTEND-038.ts declares, in the test commit, every output the unit changes: the entry shrinks, and no output grows. FRONTEND-032.ts is removed or emptied only if the budget tests require it.

Browser rows at 360, 768 and 1280, light and dark, signed in and anonymous, reported with measurements or NOT DONE: no Invite control; the + button's box (x, y, width, height) unchanged from production before this unit; the compose dialog opening from it; keyboard through nav to main.
No new dependency, third-party request, image file, or raw colour or px font size in module CSS.
wiki/CodeContext/Modules/0x08-frontend.md records the removal: the Invite entry is deleted and the components row no longer lists InviteButton or LinkIcon.
